content.json:
## Claude gateway — usage and chargeback

Every figure below comes from `ClaudeChargeback()`, the saved function over the API Management LLM log joined to the caller. Publish or refresh it with `./scripts/Publish-ClaudeQueries.ps1`.

**Read the numbers this way.** Tokens are counted, money is derived. Figures are **list price** and are not reconciled to an Azure invoice, because Azure bills Claude as one aggregated Claude Consumption Unit meter and private-offer discounts apply before that conversion. The budget counter is also **blind to cached tokens** — measured over thirty days on the reference gateway, cache reads were 38.7% of real cost weight. Real spend is therefore **higher** than anything shown here, never lower.

content.query:
ClaudeChargeback(datetime({TimeRange:startISO}), datetime({TimeRange:endISO}))
| summarize Requests = count(), Tokens = sum(total_tokens), People = dcount(user_id) by ['Business unit'] = business_unit
| order by Tokens desc
content.title: By business unit

content.query:
ClaudeChargeback(datetime({TimeRange:startISO}), datetime({TimeRange:endISO}))
| summarize Requests = count(), Tokens = sum(total_tokens) by ['Client'] = client_surface
| order by Tokens desc
content.title: By client — CLI, VS Code extension, Desktop, SDK

content.json: The client comes from the `User-Agent` the caller sends, captured on every request by the gateway policy. The surface is parsed out of the agent string rather than matched against a list — measured 2026-09-16, Claude Code 2.1.241 identifies itself as `claude-cli/2.1.241 (external, sdk-cli)`, so a hard-coded list of expected values would have mis-bucketed the real CLI. `unknown` means the caller sent no agent string.

content.query:
ClaudeChargeback(datetime({TimeRange:startISO}), datetime({TimeRange:endISO}))
| summarize Requests = count(), Tokens = sum(total_tokens), Clients = make_set(client_surface, 4) by Developer = actor, ['Business unit'] = business_unit, Tier = tier
| order by Tokens desc
| take 25
content.title: Developers by consumption

content.query:
ClaudeChargeback(datetime({TimeRange:startISO}), datetime({TimeRange:endISO}))
| summarize Tokens = sum(total_tokens) by bin(timestamp, 1h), business_unit
| render timechart
content.title: Consumption over time, by business unit

content.query:
ClaudeChargeback(datetime({TimeRange:startISO}), datetime({TimeRange:endISO}))
| summarize Requests = count(), Prompt = sum(prompt_tokens), Completion = sum(completion_tokens) by Model = model, Streamed = streamed
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Model mix

content.json:
**No caller** means the identity trace did not join — investigate, because that spend belongs to somebody. **No business unit** is the count to drive to zero before switching `bu-unassigned` to `deny`; `./scripts/Get-ClaudeBusinessUnit.ps1` reports it too. **No client** means the caller sent no `User-Agent`.

Cache tokens are absent from every row by design and recorded as `cache_tokens_known = false` rather than zero — see [ADR-0006](https://github.com/naveenneog/claude-code-foundry-gateway/blob/main/docs/adr/0006-ledger-is-the-llm-log.md).
